architecture.mechanism: Real-time monitoring of spark plug high-voltage waveforms to detect gap wear and breakdown voltage changes.
architecture.intervention: Install non-contact voltage sensors on the engine fuel system's ignition circuit to monitor spark plug high-voltage waveforms in real time, correlating breakdown voltage drops with stalling events during acceleration.
architecture.expected_effect: Early detection of spark plug gap wear or temperature-induced breakdown voltage decreases that cause intermittent misfires and stalling, enabling predictive maintenance before failure occurs.
architecture.falsification_test: Induce controlled spark plug gap widening and temperature increases on a test engine while recording high-voltage waveforms; verify if the system detects the predicted linear increase in breakdown voltage and shortened arc duration prior to induced stalling.
